purpose: Exact ties in the LGE 2026 results and how the Electoral Commission resolved them, read from its own Seat Calculation Detail reports. The seat engine never breaks a tie itself (seatCalculator.ts leaves the seat pending); a tie listed here as resolved is applied with its source, and a tie listed as unresolved stays undecided on every page.
